summary: #1538: PR subscription snapshot deduplication and cancellation

replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged PR subscription snapshot deduplication and cancellation change.

schema.detail: Adds claims_subscription_started_run_index on subscription.mission-started claims at store open without changing SQLite user_version. This index is built over retained claims; the numeric version is not evidence of downgrade compatibility.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: Subscription PR reviews already completed for an exact observation are suppressed. Active subscription runs cancel with normal cleanup when their PR head moves, closes, or becomes a draft. Authored missions keep pinned inputs and failed snapshots remain retryable; disconnected members do not share a reservation.

downtime.detail: Initial construction of the new subscription-start expression index can extend startup before serving on populated stores. No restart-to-API or restart-to-health duration was measured for this change; budget depends on retained history and storage.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration conversion required for existing installations by PR subscription snapshot deduplication and cancellation.

recovery.detail: Keep a pre-upgrade state/key/configuration backup and roll forward if startup fails. The added index is automatic; binary replacement is not a qualified store downgrade. Cancellation of superseded subscription runs is durable and is not undone by swapping binaries.
